answer: An answer must include the first 21 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the meadow derivation is checked against the saffron nonce, the sonnet audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 58 aliases produces 58 mismatches and pays the authoring cost with no payout. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
